text:
Jonathan Lekkerimäki has turned the Canucks' power play into his stage. Eleven of his 18 points have come with the man advantage, and teammates have been talking up the release: Daily Hive ran a piece on the technique behind his shot, and his top shot speed sits in the 84th percentile per NHL EDGE. At 22, through 27 games, he's scoring 0.67 points a game, almost double the median first full season for forwards picked around 15th overall.

The worry lives at five on five. With him on the ice, Vancouver gets about 40% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), and the team has been losing a lot of games around him. He's also running a little hot: 7 goals on 5.5 expected.

Right now he's pointless in four straight, but on 2.5 expected points, so the chances haven't dried up. Our range for his season lands between 41 and 63 points. Watch whether the even-strength game catches up to the power-play one.
